knownIssue.summary: The scanner read `requirements` from the release entries in /api/packages/<name>, which carry only version, url, has_docs and inserted_at. The dependency list was therefore empty for every package on hex.pm and all 15,000 were classified as using no cryptography. phoenix, which requires the catalogued plug_crypto, was counted as crypto-free.
knownIssue.correctedIn: scripts/scan-hex.mjs, 2026-07-28. Against the fixed scanner 9 of the top 300 Hex packages by downloads resolve to a catalogued dependency. The corrected figures land with the next published corpus.

knownIssue.summary: Enumeration paginated /api/search with an empty query, and pub.dev caps a blank search at ten pages of ten. It scanned 100 packages of the roughly 86,000 pub.dev publishes, and reported no fetch errors while doing it.
knownIssue.correctedIn: scripts/scan-pub.mjs, 2026-07-28. /api/package-names returns every name in one response; verified live at 85,865. The corrected figures land with the next published corpus.
